crossRefs.note: I run in the path of your commandments, for you have set my heart free.
Turn my heart toward your statutes, not toward selfish gain.
So I will obey your law continually, forever and ever.
I will walk in liberty, for I have sought your precepts.
I opened my mouth wide and panted, for I longed for your commandments.
Consider how I love your precepts. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your loving kindness.
Let your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.
Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.
“But this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days,” says Yahweh: “I will put my law…
For I delight in God’s law after the inward man,
May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love, and into the perseverance of Christ.
make you complete in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is well pleasing in his sight, through…

translations.web: Oh that my ways were steadfast to obey your statutes!
translations.bsb: Oh, that my ways were committed to keeping Your statutes!
translations.kjv: O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes!
translations.asv: Oh that my ways were established To observe thy statutes!
